The fine print

  1. All call types not listed will be charged in addition to your Monthly Access Fee. Please call Customer Care on 1300 58 MINT for these rates
  2. A Flagfall of 45c applies to all timed calls not included in the monthly access fee
  3. Early Termination Fees (ETF) apply for contract periods. ETF is $99 per service that cancels within the 6 month contract period
  4. The Mint Telecom Fair Use Policy applies. For a copy of the Mint Telecom Customer Terms (SFOA, & FUP) please visit the information page 
  5. These plans are not intended or approved for resale or commercial purposes including high volume telemarketing
  6. Unlimited NBN is subject to the Mint Telecom Fair Use Policy. Speed for Internet services will vary depending on your individual circumstance and factors such as your hardware, quality of your wiring and distance from the exchange.
  7. All prices are inclusive of GST.
